title: Battleship New Jersey Museum

services.name: Guided Tour
services.desc: Tours are every day, and start promptly at 12:00 PM, please plan to arrive at least 10 minutes before your tour is set to begin. Certain times of year during the holiday season and summer, we also offer guided tours at 2:00 PM! A 90-minute journey through American Fire Power history! Our knowledgeable tour guide will take you through the Battleship’s awesome 16″ Gun Turrets and other weapons systems, the Admiral’s and Captain’s Cabins, Navigational Bridge, Wardroom, Berthing Area and much more.
